S. 2621 JAN 3 • PUNONG BARANGAY ROCKY M. ALIPING Barangay Gen. Emilio F. Aguinaldo-Lower Q.M. Baguio City Dear PB Aliping: This has reference to your December 3, 2023 letter seeking guidance regarding the deadline for payment of Liga membership dues in relation to the conduct of Liga Municipal/CC/HUC/CC synchronized elections. Your request for guidance stemmed from the issuance of LnB Memorandum Circular Memorandum Circular 2023-001 by the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board which contains the guidelines for the conduct of the Liga ng mga Barangay elections. Pertinently, MC 2023-001 states: "H. In the NEB Meeting conducted last II November 2023 at the Sheraton Hotel Manila, the NEB has set the following additional qualifications for the conduct of the elections. a. xxx b. Any representative of a barangay/chapter who fall under the following, shall not be eligible run for office: • FOR PROVINCIAL/HUC/ICC CHAPTER ELECTIONS Representatives of Barangays or Municipal/CC Chapters that did not pay their Liga Dues by the August 31 deadline prescribed by the National Liga. • FOR MUNICIPAL/CC CHAPTER ELECTIONS Representatives of barangays who did not pay their Liga Dues by the deadline prescribed by the incumbent Liga President (emphasis ours). " It was stated that your predecessor failed to settle the said Liga dues before the August 31 deadline. You now contend that, as a newly elected Punong Barangay, the non-payment of Liga dues should not prejudice your intention to run as President of the Liga ng mga Barangay Baguio Chapter. In reply thereto, please be informed that the issue raised has become moot and academic by the supervening issuance on December 12, 2023 of LnB Memorandum Circular No. 2023-10 officially recalling Memorandum Circulars Nos. 2023-001 and 2023-002. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

In this connection, the Department issued an Advisory dated December 14, 2023 entitled "Liga ng mga Barangay Memorandum Circular No. 2023-010 Recalling Memorandum Circulars Nos. 2023-001 and 2023-002". The relevant portion of the Advisory is quoted hereunder: Under Memorandum No. 2023-10, the LnB has removed the requirement for payment of membership dues on or before 31 August 2023 as a prerequisite for participation in the chapter elections. Article VI relevantly provides: Article VI 1. All barangays are required to update the full payment of their 2023 Liga Dues and to sign a promissory note FORM 9 to pay their 2024 Liga Dues before January 10, 2024 in order to vote in the Municipal/CC/HUC/CC synchronized elections on December 15, 2023 2. All Liga Chapters are required to remit the full payment of all 2019 to 2024 Liga Dues, 2024 Liga Dues plus full payment of the 2024 Subscription to the Liga National Office Publication in order for the chapters to vote in the Provincial/Regional and National Synchronized Elections. The barangay representative in the LnB chapter elections need only update their membership dues, in accordance with the above provision, before the scheduled Liga elections to participate (to vote and be voted upon) in the said chapter elections. This opinion is being rendered based on the facts as represented and without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very tr ours, AUTHO ITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. J ICTOR R. LLAMAS Un retary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSE JVRULLLS-LRALLD/jvpr copy furnished: ARACELI A.
